changes.summary: init bind --adopter-policy projects the owned project.json keys from the ownership matrix: a declared key replaces the current value as a whole, and an owned key the source does not declare is retired. A key the earlier deep merge preserved but the source never declared, such as ci_economy.attested_rc, is deleted on the first rebind.

The package scorecard N/A default gains F4:T5, Inventory x Idiomaticity, with its Article 5 reason. An adopter source that declares scorecard_na replaces the default as a whole, so F4:T5 stays scoreable unless the source lists it.

The canonical forbidden-actions policy exempts validated append-only maintenance of law/policy/forbidden-action-authorizations.json from FORBID-MUTATE-INVARIANTS, so a receipt commit is no longer a finding once operational law is rebound.
The subprocess effects registry declares the gh run list and governed vitest read templates the harness sensors run; rebinding subprocess effects materializes them byte for byte.

Check members classify the repository from the bound adopter-policy receipt. A repository without .devai/config/adopter-policy-binding.json is unclassified and fails closed with CHECK_REPOSITORY_KIND_INVALID.

obligation.requirement: Bind an adopter policy source under law/policy with init bind --adopter-policy so the receipt names a policy_id in the adopter's own namespace.

changes.summary: Constitution 1.0.2 amends Article 6 so an adopter may declare client extensions by root and path class; the core path rows are unchanged. Binding it replaces the vendored copy and the project.json pin.

obligation.requirement: Bind the installed constitution with init upgrade --constitution (or init bind --constitution) after the Architect has reviewed the amendment.

changes.summary: The adopter policy may declare an optional closed authority block naming roots, test selectors and architecture selectors; init bind compiles it into an additive authority extension recorded as authority_extension in the binding receipt. It requires constitution 1.0.2 bound first and changes nothing for a source without the block.

The thresholds schema requires the soft_gate block, the scored soft gate constants. Rebinding operational law and the adopter policy materializes the package constants; a source that overrides thresholds.soft_gate must keep them.

obligation.requirement: The materialized .devai/config/thresholds.json carries the soft_gate block and validates against law/schemas/thresholds.schema.json.

changes.summary: evidence verify --scope chain cross-checks every proof line against the chain. The first verification writes the append-only record/proofs/anchor-baseline.json, and legacy proof lines without an anchor need an Architect-authorized historical-gap declaration; they are never re-anchored.

obligation.requirement: Run evidence verify --scope chain; when it lists unanchored legacy lines, the Architect records one historical-gap declaration naming each line before the next verification.

changes.summary: The subprocess effects registry declares the build template with its argv precedence, the two Pages gh api GET shapes, and the --workflow and --event gh run list forms; rebinding subprocess effects materializes them byte for byte.

Opt-in experimental agent execution: round dispatch runs agent tasks through host CLI providers only under an unexpired Owner activation record written by the Owner-only round dispatch activate into .devai/state/experimental/activation.json and an explicit --experimental consent. An adopter that writes no activation record sees no change. The Owner-only round dispatch dispose and round dispatch deactivate record the disposition of uncertain work and the withdrawal of an activation (ADR-MDL-0007).

Campaign rounds reach the runtime through campaign status, campaign materialize and round ratify; the authority policy is rematerialized from the installed action registry so the new actions are governed.

init upgrade plans the move from the bound devai_version to the installed version from this manifest, refuses an undeclared owned-key retirement before any write, and with --write runs the bind segments in canonical order, checks the result with doctor, and records an upgrade receipt.

The subprocess effects registry declares the git rev-parse --git-common-dir read the trusted authority sources run to derive the repository id; rebinding subprocess effects materializes it byte for byte.

The trusted local-RC verifier pin moves from @aarusso-nyx/devai@1.5.4 to @aarusso-nyx/devai@1.9.0. A repository that declares ci_economy.attested_rc regenerates the byte-compared verifier workflow from the installed package.
